subject.title: RFC: Skill routing metadata and evaluation hints for Harness-style OpenClaw setups

question: Should ClawHub adopt an advisory routing-and-evaluation metadata contract, and if so which v1 fields belong in the durable public manifest/API contract?
rationale: The request introduces new public schema and trust semantics; source-adjacent metadata does not determine whether routing, risk, verification, or playbook declarations should be standardized or how consumers may rely on them.

options.title: Stage a narrow advisory v1
options.body: Standardize optional routing intents/keywords and verification hints, expose raw metadata through API/CLI, and explicitly keep risk fields informational only.

options.title: Adopt the full proposed contract
options.body: Define routing, advisory risk, verification, and playbook fields together with validation and misuse-resistant documentation before exposing them publicly.

options.title: Defer the registry contract
options.body: Keep the current generic metadata model and revisit once a concrete Harness consumer can validate a stable field set.

recommendation.title: Stage a narrow advisory v1
recommendation.body: Standardize optional routing intents/keywords and verification hints, expose raw metadata through API/CLI, and explicitly keep risk fields informational only.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged manifest metadata work is the closest established implementation surface for assessing a compatible extension.
